changes.question:

W) donates a pair of electrons
X) accepts a pair of electrons
Y) produces H+ ions in aqueous solution
Z) produces OH− ions in aqueous solution

X) accepts a pair of electrons
Y) produces H<sup>+</sup> ions in aqueous solution
Z) produces OH<sup>−</sup> ions in aqueous solution
changes.answer: Y) PRODUCES H<sup>+</sup> IONS IN AQUEOUS SOLUTION
